## Install

1. Download `NoDistractions.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Move **No Distractions.app** into `/Applications`.
3. Open it. A moon appears in the menu bar; there is no Dock icon.

This build is signed with a Developer ID and notarised by Apple, so it opens
without warnings and needs no `xattr` workaround. To start it at login, turn on
**Settings ▸ Start at Login** in the moon menu.
